evidence: SPELLING: extracted all 669 distinct words of instruction.md + both notes and reviewed the list by hand; no misspellings found. The only variation is regional: instruction.md:15 'honour PORT' / 'honouring DB_PATH' (British) vs integration.md:7 'honoring' (American, template-controlled text, identical to the template's first 14 lines). That is not a real spelling error, and the template part cannot be edited. CONTAMINATION: grep over the three files for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|<tag>|drive-letter paths|/home/|/Users/|turing|qc|judge|rubric|criteri|grader|claude|codex finds nothing. All three files are pure ASCII with no CRLF. No author asides, duplicated paragraphs or another machine's paths. The template's CHANGE_ME lines were replaced (instruction.md:1 is a real request, and notes.md is not shipped; the task supplies hireops_rules.md instead). CONTRADICTIONS (cross-checked one fact at a time): password Hireops!2026 appears identically at instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11. The accounts in instruction.md:19 (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates) exactly match the 10 seed users and their roles. There is one seed path (/assets/seed_data.json) at instruction.md:15, integration.md:7 and rules:214. One DB path: /app/app.db plus DB_PATH. One port: 3000, with 'honour PORT' compatible because test.sh:108/164 launches with PORT=3000 and rules:209 lists PORT as available. The update window is 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5) and '15 seconds' (rules:122). Health 'never touches the database' (instruction.md:15) is compatible with the template's 'answers before database work can block startup'. Stage order in rules:43 matches seed stages. The candidate wording table at rules:190-197 matches seed candidate_status_labels exactly. Page size 30 (rules:150,217) matches seed thread_page_size 30. 'three jobs' matches 3 seed jobs. 'one conversation is long' matches APP-101 with 120 messages, the others having 1-3. 'a few internal notes' matches 3. The read-marker semantics (rules:215-216) match seed reads.read_count. The activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (rules:115) is consistent: Priya Nair APP-103 is in SCREEN and recruiters may move any job's cards. The 409 refusal naming who (rules:79-81) is consistent with instruction.md:3. Drafts per user and per conversation, surviving reload and sign-out (instruction.md:7), are consistent with rules:176-181. Candidate exclusions in instruction.md:9 are consistent with rules:199-202. No clock value is stated anywhere, so there are no conflicting clocks. LESSONS FILE: patterns bearing on this row are lesson 18 (fixes introduce new issues) and the contradiction family. The visible edit splice is hireops_rules.md:99. It is the only line over 110 characters (155 chars, unwrapped, where the rest of the file wraps at about 100) and carries the inserted 'rejecting or reopening a card counts as a move here too'. It renders as normal Markdown prose and contradicts nothing (rules:102-104 and activity rules:114 agree), so it is cosmetic only. COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS: (a) A conforming app failing because of a contradictory fact: none found. Every runtime fact a builder could pick from two places agrees, including PORT, which the verifier sets to 3000. (b) A broken app passing does not apply to this text-hygiene row. One adjacent ambiguity is handed to row 6, not this row: whether a re-order counts as 'a later move' that ends undo eligibility (rules:99,103-104). The text never contradicts itself on this point. It is silent.
